### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=True
set +e
runtime_version=$(/opt/llama-server --version 2>&1 | head -3)
if test -r '/home/operator/load example.sh'; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_readable=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_readable=failed
fi
if bash -n '/home/operator/load example.sh'; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_syntax=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_syntax=failed
fi
if test "$(sha256sum '/home/operator/load example.sh' | awk '{print $1}')" = eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_hash=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_hash=failed
fi
if test "$(stat -c %a '/home/operator/load example.sh')" = 644; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_mode=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_mode=failed
fi
if test -x /opt/llama-server; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_runtime_executable=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_runtime_executable=failed
fi
if test -r /models/example-00001.gguf; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_primary_model=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_primary_model=failed
fi
if case "$(systemctl --user is-system-running 2>/dev/null)" in running|degraded) true ;; *) false ;; esac; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_user_manager=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_user_manager=failed
fi
if test "$(stat -c %s '/home/operator/load example.sh')" = 10; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_size=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_script_size=failed
fi
if test "$(stat -c %s /models/example-00001.gguf)" = 20; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_primary_model_size=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_primary_model_size=failed
fi
if test -r /models/example-00001.gguf; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_model_file_1=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_model_file_1=failed
fi
if test -r '/models/x'"'"'y.gguf'; then
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_model_file_2=ok
else
  printf '%s\n' CHECK_model_file_2=failed
fi
printf '%s\n' "RUNTIME_VERSION_B64=$(printf '%s' "$runtime_version" | base64 -w0)"
awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print "MEM_AVAILABLE=" $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo
awk '/^SwapTotal:/ {total=$2} /^SwapFree:/ {print "SWAP_USED=" (total-$2) * 1024}' /proc/meminfo
### call 2: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=True
set -u
unit=$(systemctl --user list-units 'dgx-model-*' --type=service --all \
  --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '$3 != "inactive" {print $1; exit}')
active=inactive
sub=dead
pid=0
if [ -n "$unit" ]; then
  active=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null \
    || printf inactive)
  sub=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p SubState --value 2>/dev/null || printf dead)
  pid=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || printf 0)
fi
legacy_pid=0
if [ "$pid" = 0 ]; then
  legacy_pid=$(pgrep -f 'build/bin/llama-server -m' 2>/dev/null \
    | head -1 || true)
  legacy_pid=${legacy_pid:-0}
fi
observed_pid=$pid
if [ "$observed_pid" = 0 ]; then observed_pid=$legacy_pid; fi
cmdline=
if [ "$observed_pid" != 0 ] && [ -r "/proc/$observed_pid/cmdline" ]; then
  cmdline=$(tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$observed_pid/cmdline" | base64 -w0)
fi
health=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 \
  http://192.0.2.10:11434/health 2>/dev/null || true)
models=$(curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://192.0.2.10:11434/v1/models \
  2>/dev/null || true)
models_b64=$(printf '%s' "$models" | base64 -w0)
# Foreign GPU workloads: containers with GPU access that no configured recipe
# owns, and host GPU processes outside any container when no unit is observed.
known_containers=''
gpu_format='{{.Name}}|{{json .HostConfig.DeviceRequests}}'
gpu_format="$gpu_format|{{json .HostConfig.Devices}}"
foreign_containers=
for cid in $(docker ps -q 2>/dev/null | head -32); do
  info=$(docker inspect --format "$gpu_format" "$cid" 2>/dev/null) || continue
  cname=${info%%|*}
  cname=${cname#/}
  case " $known_containers " in *" $cname "*) continue ;; esac
  case "$info" in
    *'"gpu"'*|*nvidia.com/gpu*|*/dev/nvidia*)
      foreign_containers="$foreign_containers $cname" ;;
  esac
done
host_gpu=
if [ "$observed_pid" = 0 ] && command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for gpid in $(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader \
      2>/dev/null | head -16); do
    case "$gpid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    if grep -qsE 'docker|containerd|libpod' "/proc/$gpid/cgroup"; then continue; fi
    comm=$(tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._:-' < "/proc/$gpid/comm" 2>/dev/null || true)
    host_gpu="$host_gpu ${comm:-process}:$gpid"
  done
fi
foreign_endpoints=
# Observation has a 15 second SSH budget: probe at most six ports, one second
# each, so ports that accept but never answer cannot time the whole call out.
if [ 8000 -gt 0 ]; then
  for port in $(ss -ltnH 2>/dev/null | awk -v lo=8000 -v hi=8999 \
      '{n = split($4, a, ":"); p = a[n] + 0; if (p >= lo && p <= hi) print p}' \
      | sort -nu | head -6); do
    case " 11434 " in *" $port "*) continue ;; esac
    body=$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 1 \
      "http://127.0.0.1:$port/v1/models" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$body" ]; then
      foreign_endpoints="$foreign_endpoints $port=$(printf '%s' "$body" | base64 -w0)"
    fi
  done
fi
mem_total=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)
mem_available=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)
swap_total=$(awk '/^SwapTotal:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)
swap_free=$(awk '/^SwapFree:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)
printf '%s\n' \
  "HOSTNAME=$(hostname)" "UNIT=$unit" "ACTIVE=$active" "SUB=$sub" \
  "PID=$pid" "LEGACY_PID=$legacy_pid" "CMDLINE_B64=$cmdline" \
  "HEALTH_CODE=$health" "MODELS_B64=$models_b64" \
  "MEM_TOTAL=$mem_total" "MEM_AVAILABLE=$mem_available" \
  "SWAP_TOTAL=$swap_total" "SWAP_FREE=$swap_free" \
  "FOREIGN_CONTAINERS=$foreign_containers" "HOST_GPU_PROCESSES=$host_gpu" \
  "FOREIGN_ENDPOINTS=$foreign_endpoints" \
  "UPTIME_SECONDS=$(cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime)"
### end
